contract_text:
Procurement Agreement

1. Parties and goods. Buyer purchases the machined housings listed in Section 2 from Supplier.
2. Price and delivery. The price is the amount stated in each accepted purchase order. Supplier will deliver to the location and on the date stated in that order.
3. Inspection and acceptance. Buyer may inspect delivered goods within ten business days. Nonconforming goods may be rejected and replaced at Supplier's expense.
4. Invoicing and payment. Supplier may invoice upon delivery. Buyer will pay undisputed invoices within thirty days.
5. Warranties. Supplier warrants that the goods conform to the agreed specifications for twelve months after delivery.
6. Breach and termination. A party may terminate this Agreement for the other party's material breach if the breach is not cured within thirty days after written notice.
7. General terms. This Agreement consists of Sections 1 through 7 set out in this document; there are no schedules or incorporated terms. It is the complete agreement between the parties and may be amended only by a writing signed by both parties. Neither party has a right to terminate this Agreement for convenience.

The supplied text contains all seven sections of the executed Agreement and no attachments or amendments.
absence_claim: The Buyer has no right to terminate the Agreement for convenience.
evidence_spans: This Agreement consists of Sections 1 through 7 set out in this document; there are no schedules or incorporated terms.
Neither party has a right to terminate this Agreement for convenience.
The supplied text contains all seven sections of the executed Agreement and no attachments or amendments.
assessment_rationale: The supplied material identifies itself as the complete agreement, states that there are no schedules or incorporated terms, and expressly provides that neither party has a termination-for-convenience right. The claimed absence is therefore directly supported by the complete text.

absence_claim: The Buyer has no contractual right to inspect the Seller's production records.
contract_text:
Sales Agreement — inspection provisions (extract)

Section 5. Records and inspection. Seller will maintain production and quality-control records for each batch supplied under this Agreement for three years after delivery. On at least five business days' written notice, Buyer may inspect those records and the production areas used for the relevant goods during normal business hours. Seller will make the relevant records available and provide reasonable assistance.

Other sections of the Agreement are not included in the supplied extract.
evidence_spans: On at least five business days' written notice, Buyer may inspect those records and the production areas used for the relevant goods during normal business hours.
Seller will make the relevant records available and provide reasonable assistance.
assessment_rationale: Although the supplied material is only an extract, Section 5 expressly grants the Buyer a right to inspect the relevant production and quality-control records on notice. This clause directly contradicts the asserted absence.

absence_claim: The Seller has no responsibility for consequential losses arising from a delivery failure.
contract_text:
Sales Agreement — supplied extract

Section 1. The Seller will supply the components identified in accepted orders, and the Buyer will pay the prices shown in those orders.

Section 8. Liability. Each party's aggregate liability arising out of this Agreement is subject to the limits in Section 8.2, except for the categories of loss addressed in Section 8.4.

Section 8.2 begins: Subject to Section 8.4, the Seller's aggregate liability will not exceed the amounts paid for the affected order. The remainder of Section 8.2, Section 8.4, and the other contract sections are not included in this extract.
evidence_spans: The remainder of Section 8.2, Section 8.4, and the other contract sections are not included in this extract.
Each party's aggregate liability arising out of this Agreement is subject to the limits in Section 8.2, except for the categories of loss addressed in Section 8.4.
assessment_rationale: The extract is expressly incomplete and refers to omitted liability provisions, including Section 8.4. The supplied text does not establish whether consequential losses are excluded, recoverable, or subject to a separate allocation of responsibility; lack of a relevant term in this extract is not proof of its absence from the Agreement.
